title: Lots o' Guns X All Of YUNG's
description: A ModPack that adds compatibility to Lots o' Guns and All Of YUNG's.
body:
In this ModPack,\
you will explore the already friendly world of Minecraft with a slight twist.\
That being *GUNS*.\
Also there is now compatibility between Lots o' Guns and All Of YUNG's.

Make guns, ammo and atachments like\
scopes, extended mags, stocks, muzzles and even lasers!\
All made possible with the TacZ Mod, now in Fabric with the TacZ: Refabricated Mod.

Here you can snipe, just shoot with\
rifles, SMGs, pistols and shotguns.\
You'll want to download this ModPack not just because of the guns,\
but also the stunning viwes you'll get with Distant Horizons and theres also shader support.

Features:

1. Guns & Ammo
2. Atatchments
3. Great Terrain Generation
4. Amazing Views
5. Shader Support
6. Amazing Structures

For any help or bug reports, join my discord using this link: https://discord.gg/C9b3anUaP9
